name: mcp-maer-server
description: 🦁 MAER MCP Server — Motor multimodal de análisis documental, OCR, validación de IDs mexicanos y reconocimiento facial

scripts.llm:status: $HOME/miniforge3_x86/envs/maer_env/bin/python -c "import requests,json; r=requests.get('http://localhost:8765/api/llm-status',timeout=5); d=r.json().get('data',{}); print('Ollama:',d.get('ollama',{}).get('modelo_activo','❌')); print('Groq:','✅' if d.get('groq',{}).get('disponible') else '❌'); print('Motor recomendado:',d.get('motor_recomendado'))"
scripts.lint: $HOME/miniforge3_x86/envs/maer_env/bin/python -m py_compile maer_backend/maer_files.py maer_backend/ocr_engine.py maer_backend/maer.py && echo '✓ Sin errores de sintaxis'
scripts.env:check: $HOME/miniforge3_x86/envs/maer_env/bin/python -c "import torch, easyocr, paddleocr, deepface, fastapi, anthropic, groq, langchain; print('✓ Entorno maer_env OK — Groq SDK incluido')"
